name: Spawn Guard
description: Protects the overworld spawn build (no breaking or placing, ender chests and other containers stay usable), gives Mining Fatigue III in spawn, and runs the 8 rentable spawn plots where renters build and break only their own blocks. Players take no fall damage and cannot hurt each other in spawn; areas in config/spawn-guard-areas.json can only be changed by their owners and ops. Server-side only.
